summary: A colleague's wife told him to choose between the office and the family, and he resigned.
realLife: A former mayor recalled a fellow officeholder whose wife did not understand what the job demanded. She gave him a choice between her and the family or the office. He chose to resign.
gates: A named officeholder with a spouse sits on the same body.
The body has met late or on weekends for months.
inGame: A body member with a spouse, kin ties, and a seat can be vacated; the office-doubt scene and a resignation can carry it.

turns.what: The colleague stays and the marriage ends.
turns.pulledBy: Pride, a long career in the seat.
turns.writesBack: Household splits; the seat stays held.

turns.what: The spouse says it once and the two settle on fewer evenings out.
turns.pulledBy: Trust, a spouse with their own job.
turns.writesBack: A shorter meeting load on the member's calendar.

turns.what: The resignation comes after the next election year.
turns.pulledBy: A pending bill the member wants to finish.
turns.writesBack: A vacancy record at a later date; the household stays together.
